denominator_selection: reconstructed GSF electron with 5 < pT < 10 GeV passing the ECAL fiducial region, conversion veto, and lostHits <= 1, without a cutBased or mini-isolation requirement
target_selection: cutBased >= 1; miniPFRelIso_all is not an additional probe pass/fail requirement
tag_selection: tight electron with pT > 5 GeV and miniPFRelIso_all < 0.1; no electron trigger-object match is applied

bins.reason: nominal data or MC fit failed
nominal data or MC fit failed

adoption_note: All nominal and systematic fits, closure tests, and trigger-object audits must pass before status may become adopted.
